collection.description: Walking on the shore late at night, a villager finds that the water lights up with soft blue sparks.

setup.name: The moment
setup.text: Walking along the shore late at night, (name1) kicks at the edge of a wave, and the water lights up. Little blue sparks scatter around (his/her) foot, then fade. (He/She) kicks again. More sparks. (He/She) wades in to (his/her) knees and swishes (his/her) hands through the water, and every movement leaves a trail of soft blue light, like stars poured into the sea. (name1) doesn't know what it is. Tiny living things? Magic? Something else entirely? (He/She) stands there for a long time, drawing shapes of light in the water, and doesn't try to work it out.
